name: @snow-the/dsh-orchestrator
description: Ticket-based orchestration for DSH: durable work tickets, a crash-recoverable outbox over ctx.sessionController, and a structured report path so ticket state is never inferred from a worker's free text.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.js --external:@deepseek-ai/* --log-level=warning && esbuild src/core.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/core.js --log-level=warning
